test_modeling_rt_detr: test the RT_DETR PyTorch model with configurable batch size, image size, and label generation for object detection
create_rt_detr_model_tester: create an RTDetrModelTester instance to generate model configs, pixel values, masks, and labels for unit testing
test_attention_outputs: test encoder, decoder, and cross-attention output shapes and layer counts for RTDetrModel and RTDetrForObjectDetection
test_hidden_states_output: test encoder and decoder hidden state output shapes and layer counts with output_hidden_states enabled
